description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MenuItemAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various scenarios for the 'getOne' method under different configurations and verifies that certain API methods are not implemented.

classes.name: MenuItemAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the MenuItemAPI endpoints in various scenarios.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MenuItemAPI with fixtures where leave and timesheet periods are defined.

methods.name: testGetOne2
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MenuItemAPI with fixtures where leave and timesheet periods are not defined.

methods.name: testGetOne3
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of MenuItemAPI when the Time Module is disabled.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that the update method of MenuItemAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that the getValidationRuleForUpdate method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method of MenuItemAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that getValidationRuleForDelete throws a not implemented exception.
